name: beautiful-reactnative
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic React Native + Expo apps on TypeScript: three skills distilled from the React Native and Expo documentation, the facta mobile handbook, and the mobile performance guidance, plus a drop-in eslint config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for React Native + Expo developers on TypeScript, distilled from the React Native and Expo documentation, the facta mobile handbook, and the mobile performance guidance.

reactnative-best-practices guides new mobile code: the View -> ViewModel -> SDK contract, the five screen states, TanStack Query and the outbox, deep-link and push parsing, device tiers and the quality governor, FlashList/expo-image, the tiered SceneEngine port, secure storage, accessibility, and the unbreakable layer contract.

reactnative-review reviews a screen, ViewModel, navigation/deep-link parser, SDK, offline code, push handling, scene adapter, or diff and returns a prioritized report. Architecture and device-tier contracts rank above everything. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

reactnative-port ports a web React app, a bare RN app, a legacy screen, or a native screen to Expo + the New Architecture with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a Node.js toolchain is available, the skills run tsc, eslint, and vitest on your project; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in eslint config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Write idiomatic React Native + Expo apps
Review mobile apps with cited rules
Port web or legacy screens with the same behavior
defaultPrompt: Review this orders screen and list what to fix first
Port this web React screen to React Native
Design the offline and outbox path for this feature

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three mobile skills, the layer and device-tier contract, and a proven eslint config.
